name: Condescending Wonka
look: Gene Wilder as Willy Wonka rests his head on one hand and gives a smug, knowing half-smile. He wears a brown top hat, a purple velvet coat, a large tan bow tie and a pink floral waistcoat.
use: Sarcastic, patronizing replies to someone's naive or self-important claim. The top caption usually starts with "Oh, you..." and repeats what they said, and the bottom caption mocks it, often with "Tell me more about..."
slots: top caption: 'Oh, you...' plus their naive claim
examples: Please, tell me more about your 5K
Oh, you'll start your diet on Monday?
describe: willy wonka smirking with his head resting on his hand
gene wilder in a purple coat and top hat looking smug
man in a top hat leaning on his hand smiling sarcastically
smug chocolate factory owner saying tell me more
patronizing smile from wonka in a bow tie
origin: Gene Wilder as Willy Wonka in the 1971 film Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory.
